_README: Pinned material map for office_room_blinds.obj — the base room plus the Venetian_Blinds group (Rad_Blind_R070 -> diffuse plastic, refl 0.70; an interior shade, NOT type:context which is for external shading). Keys cover every OBJ group so these exact values win over the auto-map. up_axis Z (Z-up Blender export). ORIENTATION (re-authored 2026-07-05): modelled in the true-north frame, north_angle_deg 0; the window sits in the SOUTH (-Y) wall so at north_angle_deg 0 it is SOUTH-facing. NOTE: unlike office_room.obj, this re-exported blinds OBJ does NOT contain a Rad_Luminaire_L09 group (the electric luminaires live only in the pre-authored radiance/ scenes for this variant), so this map intentionally omits the luminaire key. See office_room_material_map.json for the base-room notes.
